events.title: How The V.F Corporation (VFC) Investment Narrative Is Shifting With New Targets And Brand Concerns
events.body: The latest update to the V.F. analyst narrative centers on a higher fair value estimate, which has moved from US$16.95 to US$20.70. Some firms have raised or trimmed price targets, with bullish calls pointing to improved execution potential

events.title: COLM Q1 Earnings Beat Estimates, International Strength Continues
events.body: COLM tops first-quarter estimates, as international sales strength offsets U.S. weakness, even as profits fall and tariff pressures weigh on margins.
